title: Google Jules opens wait list for major update
summary: Google Jules is preparing a major update and has opened a wait list for early access. A headline feature is continuous background execution so tasks keep running after a user closes their laptop. The wait list is widely linked to a successor project.

web_findings.title: Jules - An Autonomous Coding Agent
web_findings.snippet: Public beta, async coding agent that runs tasks in remote VMs.

web_findings.title: Project Jitro waitlist
web_findings.snippet: Successor product Project Jitro reportedly tied to the new wait list, with Google I/O 2026 cited as likely announcement window.
